newsitem.title: UK: Benetton unit launches anti-racism ads on MTV.
newsitem.headline: Benetton unit launches anti-racism ads on MTV.

text.p: A marketing school run by Benetton, the Italian clothing group, announced on Friday an advertising campaign against racism that it would run on MTV Europe, the music-based television channel.
Fabrica, a "communications research school" established by Benetton, said in a statement it would run six ads from March 21 to 25, to mark today's United Nations' "World Day Against Racism".
Benetton has a reputation as the wild child of the advertising world because of some of its ads that focus on subjects like race, sex, AIDS, war and death.
MTV Europe, a music and youth entertainment network available in 37 countries in Europe, is owned by Viacom International Inc.
